summary: All three code-written lines that told the player what the octopus feels are fixed in /home/user/ppolppol-fix-honest (branch fix-honest, base 6d03faf, nothing committed). (1) The bubble after petting now reads just '…'. Before, it said '…좋아' ("I like it"). (2) In the screen-reader scene description, the happy state is described by what it shows, '통통 뛰고 있어' (bouncing), instead of '신나 있어' (excited). (3) The nap label is always '자는 중' (asleep); it no longer alternates with '꿈꾸는 중' (dreaming). Everything else about these behaviours is unchanged: the 70 % chance of a bubble after a pet, the 2 s timing, the heart particle, the salon clearing a pending pet bubble, the awake-window rule, and the 9-15 s nap timer that checks whether the octopus wakes on its own. The four docs that quoted the old lines now carry a dated 11-13 note. Each change has a new behavioural check in smoke scenario A, under a new block called A-2. Reverting any one fix makes exactly its own check fail (79 passed, 1 failed each time). Results: npm test passed (exit 0), the font check says stale: none, and smoke A passed twice with A-2 included (A ran inside the A,Y runs; total 103 passed). Smoke Y did not run clean in this tree. Both A,Y runs stopped at smoke.js:2644 on a 5 s wait in the sheet-close block, before Y reaches the petting checks. An untouched copy of 6d03faf stopped at the same block at the same load (about 15, from other agents' browsers), so it is not caused by this change. I then ran Y twice in a scratch copy with every 5 s wait raised to 30 s. All the petting/salon (E2) checks passed both times (98 passed, 1 failed). The one failure was the wall-clock 4.5 s reduced-motion timing (4549 and 4974 ms), which docs/SALON.md already records as failing on a busy machine. The sweep for other feeling words found no other code line outside the demo data, apart from one empty-album line. The demo brain's lines in js/world.js do say the octopus liked, enjoyed or wanted something. They carry the '데모' (demo) tag, but they still go against the wording of hard line 1. Per the brief I did not change them: they are listed in "left" for the owner to decide.

decisions:
Happy wording: I chose '통통 뛰고 있어' rather than '폴짝 뛰고 있어'. '폴짝' is also one of the model's own four reaction words, so a code-written '폴짝' in the description could be read as the model's word; '통통' only describes the motion (two hops in both 3D and 2D). With reduced motion the hops do not play, but the state lasts only about 0.9 s before the walk to the blanket, so I did not add a separate reduced-motion wording.

Pet line: I kept say(), so a '혼잣말 …' row is still written to today's log, as it was before. The brief said to keep everything else and add no new line.

Nap timer: I removed the toggle line and kept the function name scheduleDreamLabel. The timer also does the self-wake, and the owner3 lane works around sleep code, so renaming it would only add merge risk. A comment says the name is a leftover.

Docs: PLAYTEST.md:73 and PLAYTEST_FIXES.md:199 mention '꿈꾸는 중' as part of dated playtest observations. I left them as historical records. The wip/ notes are left as well.

Where the checks run: I put them inside scenario A rather than adding a new smoke letter, so they cannot collide with the letters the other lanes edit (Q, X, Z). They use the __ppolLook hook (state set at boot, octopus does not wander) and a 2D long-press.

Nap check: it speeds up only the nap timer, picked by its source containing 'scheduleDreamLabel' and a 9-15 s delay, to 40 ms. If the function is ever renamed, the check fails loudly ('fewer than 8 cycles') rather than passing silently.

Pet check: the 70 % bubble draw uses an RNG seeded from the clock that tests cannot control, so the check presses up to 10 times until a bubble appears (chance of none at all is about 6e-6). It then requires exactly one bubble whose text is exactly '…'.

guard:
Checks added in tools/smoke.js, function scenarioHonestLines (header '== A-2', called at the end of scenario A):
- 'happy check': "상태 happy 의 장면 설명은 몸짓만 — 느낌 말 없음". Boots with __ppolLook {octState:'happy'}; #scene-desc must contain '통통 뛰고 있어' and must not match FEEL_RX (/좋아|신나|기뻐|기쁘|행복|즐거|싫어|슬퍼|외로|심심|맛있|꿈/).
- 'nap check': "낮잠 이름표는 타이머가 N번 돌아도 늘 '자는 중'". Boots with __ppolLook {octState:'sleep'}, which blocks self-wake. An init script cuts only the nap timer (9-15 s, callback source contains scheduleDreamLabel) to 40 ms and records #oct-label after each firing. It needs at least 8 firings, every one reading '자는 중'.
- 'pet check': "쓰다듬기 뒤 말풍선은 '…' 하나 — 말 없음". Uses ?scene=2d and a real long-press on #oct (pointerdown, wait for state 'pet', then pointercancel), waits until the state leaves 'pet', and records bubble texts with a MutationObserver. It repeats up to 10 times until a bubble shows, then needs exactly one bubble, exactly '…'.
- Y block 12 (E2) updated as described: 12a expects before === '…'; 12b asserts neither '…' nor '…좋아' appears around the '그대로' answer.
